connector.name: Saihm MCP Server Pro
connector.registryDescription: Sovereign encrypted memory for AI agents. Sealed on your machine. Start free: say Join SAIHM.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-pro. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the saihm-admin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
env.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.coti.global/mcp.

env.name: SAIHM_SELF_JOIN
env.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool generates a non-custodial identity on this device and activates the free trial, so no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

env.name: SAIHM_MASTER_SECRET_FILE
env.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join or are restoring an existing identity. Never transmitted.

env.name: SAIHM_HOME
env.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm.
